If you are looking for an office chair, the SIHOO Doro C300 Pro V2, with its extensive personalization settings and comfort-focused features, is worth your attention.

The importance of choosing the right office chair cannot be overstated. Sitting for 40 hours a week and over 2,000 hours a year, the same chair must provide stable support and comfort.

The SIHOO Doro C300 Pro V2 is an ergonomic office chair designed to fully adapt to every user, providing a tailor-made experience for the person sitting in it.

Here are some of the core features that enable it to achieve a high level of comfort:

  • The DynaCore system provides full-body adaptive support, ensuring comfort at every contact point between the body and the chair;
  • The SyncroFlex backrest system features an extra-large contact surface that accommodates the unique spinal curves of different individuals, providing personalized dynamic tracking effects;
  • The second-generation adaptive dynamic lumbar support provides comfortable lower back support;
  • The 8D bionic armrests can be adjusted freely to the most comfortable position;

The C300 Pro V2 combines the above features to form a comprehensive and highly adaptable support system for different work environments.

The core of the SIHOO Doro C300 Pro V2 is the SyncroFlex system, which combines dual springs and a dual-slide rail structure to automatically adapt to different body types and weights. There is no need to manually adjust knobs or levers—the moment you sit down, the chair responds instantly, automatically providing personalized ergonomic support without any setup required.

One of the standout features is the upgraded Dynamic Lumbar Support 2.0 system. The lumbar support does not remain fixed in a single position but moves naturally as you change postures throughout the day. The system offers three levels of support—firm lumbar, soft lumbar, and coccyx support—to cater to different comfort preferences, whether you prefer stronger support or a softer feel.

Since the chair continuously and automatically adjusts based on the user's weight and sitting posture, it is ideal for shared spaces, such as home offices, family shared areas, or multi-person workplaces. The second-generation weight-sensing mechanism automatically fine-tunes support for each person who sits down, with no need for readjustment when switching users.

Other highlights include an extra-wide 3D headrest, a recline angle adjustable up to 135 degrees, an intelligent weight-sensing mechanism, breathable soft mesh fabric, and a pressure-relief seat cushion.

The SIHOO Doro C300 Pro V2 retails for $499.99, but 9to5Mac readers can save even more through a special offer. The SIHOO Summer Promotion runs from July 1 to July 22, during which the chair is reduced to $429.99. Enter the exclusive promo code SIHOO9to5mac6 for an additional 6% off, bringing the final price down to approximately $404.19.

In addition to purchasing directly from SIHOO, the Doro C300 Pro V2 is also available on Amazon. Regardless of where you purchase it, SIHOO offers a 30-day risk-free trial and a three-year warranty, and it complies with industry-recognized certification standards such as BIFMA and IGR.

Get this excellently supportive office chair now for as little as $404.19.
